question: ‘The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn’ was written by which of the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mark Twain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mark Twain** is the pen name of Samuel Langhorne Clemens, an American writer and humorist born on November 30, 1835.
 
• Twain is best known for his novels "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" (1876) and "The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn" (1884), the latter often called "The Great American Novel."
 
• "The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn" is recognized for its vivid descriptions of people and places along the Mississippi River.
 
• Mark Twain's writing is noted for its humor, social criticism, and portrayal of American culture and values during the 19th century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literary Style:**

 
 
• Twain’s writing style combines colloquial speech with a keen social observation, making his works both accessible and insightful.
 
• His use of regional dialects and vivid descriptions brought authenticity and life to his characters and settings.
 
 
 
• **Social Criticism:**
 
 
• "The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn" addresses themes of race, identity, and morality, offering a critical view of the pre-Civil War South.
 
• Twain’s works often critique societal norms and injustices, making them relevant to both his time and modern discussions.
 
 
 
• **Influence:**
 
 
• Mark Twain is considered one of the greatest American writers and has influenced countless authors with his unique style and themes.
 
• His books remain a staple in American literature curricula and continue to be studied for their cultural and historical significance.
 
 
 
• **Legacy:**
 
 
• Twain’s legacy extends beyond literature; he was also a noted lecturer, satirist, and entrepreneur.
 
• The Mark Twain House & Museum in Hartford, Connecticut, preserves his legacy and offers insights into his life and works.
